item.title: Case study: recovery of a corrupted 12 TB multi-device pool
item.description:
📝 Progress detection in btrfs check --repair so 46,000 commit loops abort with a clear message instead of destroying backup_roots. A btrfs rescue clean-orphan-inodes subcommand with a built-in dry-run that applies the bulletproof 5-condition check and produces a machine-readable plan. Clearer documentation that backup_roots[0.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/kdave/btrfs-progs/issues/1107

item.title: Stamp It All Programs Must Report Their Version – Michael Stapelberg
item.description:
📝 Usually, software has a name and some version number of varying granularity: Chrome Chrome 146 Chrome 146. Let me dissect: i3 version 4. With NixOS, it’s trivial: you just boot into an older system “generation” by selecting that version in the bootloader.
🔗 Read more: https://michael.stapelberg.ch/posts/2026-04-05-stamp-it-all-programs-must-report-their-version/
